Specification: This module is a thin wrapper around another specification, TCommit, adding Apalache type annotations and a concrete helper definition for the resource manager set. It declares a constant RM and a variable rmState, then instantiates TCommit without any explicit substitutions. The only top-level behavior defined locally is a concrete set RMVal containing three string identifiers, while the actual commit protocol logic and temporal properties are inherited from the instantiated module and therefore are not extracted here.
